refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
server_key_pair
A crypto_kx keypair, such as one generated by sodium_crypto_kx_keypair: the secret key followed by the public key, exactly SODIUM_CRYPTO_KX_KEYPAIRBYTES (64) bytes long.
client_key
A crypto_kx public key, exactly SODIUM_CRYPTO_KX_PUBLICKEYBYTES (32) bytes long.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
An array consisting of two strings. The first should be used for receiving data from the client. The second should be used for sending data to the client. Each string is SODIUM_CRYPTO_KX_SESSIONKEYBYTES (32) bytes long.
